summary: Burst of SSH authentication failures from 192.0.2.50 against multiple usernames (including empty). No successful login observed in this incident.

findings.statement: At least five failed SSH attempts from 192.0.2.50 within a short window (burst pattern).
Distinct usernames targeted include user and admin; one attempt used an empty username.
Auth logs alone cannot show whether the source later obtained credentials or moved laterally.

recommendation: Monitor source 192.0.2.50; consider temporary block if volume continues. No success login to investigate further from SSH auth alone.
